Senior AI Engineer
Contract - 500pd
Permanent - 80,000 - 100,000
Remote first - LDN Office Optional
About the role
We're building an AI workflow product that lets teams turn repetitive, multi-step work into reliable automated workflows powered by large language models, agents and integrations with the tools they already use.
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to lead the product technically — owning architecture, setting engineering standards and shipping the core of the platform end to end. You'll be the most senior engineer on the product, working directly with founders/leadership, design and customers to decide what we build and how we build it.
This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll write a lot of code, but you'll also shape the roadmap, make the key technical calls and help grow the team around you.
What you'll do
  • Lead the product technically — own the architecture, technical roadmap and delivery of the AI workflow platform from prototype to production at scale.
  • Build LLM-powered workflows and agents — design orchestration for multi-step workflows, tool/function calling, retrieval (RAG), memory and human-in-the-loop approval steps.
  • Make AI reliable in production — build evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, fallbacks and cost/latency controls so workflows behave predictably for customers.
  • Ship full-stack features — from backend services and APIs to the workflow builder UI, working closely with design to make complex automation feel simple.
  • Integrate with the outside world — connectors to SaaS tools, webhooks, queues and third-party APIs, with sensible auth, rate-limiting and error handling.
  • Set the engineering bar — code review, testing, CI/CD, security and documentation practices that let a small team move fast without breaking things.
  • Work with customers and stakeholders — translate real user problems into technical solutions and help prioritise what matters.
  • Mentor and hire — support and level up other engineers, and help shape how the team grows.
What we're looking for
Essential
  • Strong commercial software engineering experience (typically 6+ years), with a track record of leading the technical delivery of a product or major platform area.
  • Hands-on experience building production features on top of LLMs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models) — prompting, tool calling, RAG, structured outputs and evaluation.
  • Excellent backend skills in Python and/or TypeScript/Node.js, designing clean APIs and distributed services.
  • Experience with workflow, event-driven or queue-based systems (e.g. Temporal, Celery, SQS/Kafka, Step Functions or similar).
  • Solid cloud and DevOps fundamentals — AWS, GCP or Azure, Docker, CI/CD, infrastructure as code.
  • Good data skills — PostgreSQL, plus vector stores (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate or similar).
  • A product mindset: you care about the user, make pragmatic trade-offs and can explain technical decisions to non-technical people.
  • Comfortable owning ambiguity in a fast-moving, early-stage environment.
Nice to have
  • Experience with agent frameworks and tooling (LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, MCP, or custom orchestration).
  • LLM evaluation and observability tools (e.g. Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust, OpenTelemetry).
  • Front-end experience with React/Next.js, ideally on visual builders or canvas-style UIs.
  • Background in SaaS integrations, iPaaS or automation products (Zapier, n8n, Make-style tools).
  • Knowledge of security, data privacy and compliance for AI systems (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR).
  • Previous experience as a founding engineer, tech lead or in a scale-up.
